senses.gloss:
mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं)
Deformed, having a redundant or defective member.
m. (-ण्डः)
A boy, one from his fifth to his sixteenth year.
E.
अपि certainly, गडि to be a part of the cheek, अच् aff., the अ of the prefix is rejected, and the इ changed to ओ; otherwise, अप depreciative prefix, गम to go, and the deriv. irr.; also अपोगण्ड; in the second sense it also occurs पौगण्ड.
